title: New Pokémon Snap
subtitle: A camera on the way through Lental
summary: New Pokémon Snap is Bandai Namco Studios' photography adventure, released for Switch on 30 April 2021.
body: New Pokémon Snap is Bandai Namco Studios' photography adventure, released for Switch on 30 April 2021. Joining Professor Mirror's research team, the player travels through the Lental region in an automated vehicle and photographs wild Pokémon. The fixed route leaves attention free to follow behavior across the surrounding habitat. A creature partly hidden in vegetation or interacting with another can become the reason to turn the camera away from an obvious subject, making observation and timing the central actions of the expedition.

Returning to a course raises its research level and can reveal different Pokémon and interactions. Nighttime routes change the same habitat again. New tools provide ways to influence the scene and create another photographic opportunity, while the rating system distinguishes the rarity of behavior as well as the quality of a picture. Learning a route therefore means remembering what happens and noticing how it changes. A familiar stretch can supply a photograph that was impossible to anticipate during the first quiet ride through it.

The laboratory connects the courses to the growing research record, with photographs reviewed and collected into an album. Editing and online sharing extend the life of a favorite shot beyond the trip that produced it. Directed by Haruki Suzaki, the game develops the observation-based premise of the 1999 Nintendo 64 original around detailed habitats and a larger range of behavior. A free update added further courses and Pokémon in August 2021, giving the return journey more places in which to wait for an unexpected moment.
